title.narrative: Operationalization and sustainability of integrated agro-industrial parks in Ethiopia

description.narrative: The general objective of the project is to contribute to agro-industry development, employment and improved income earning opportunities in high agriculture productive areas of the country. The specific objective is to support the inclusive and sustainable development of the four pilot integrated agro-industrial parks in the regions of Oromia (Bulbula), SNNP (Yerga Alem), Amara (Bure) and Tigray (Baeker)
